title: CLI uplift evaluation result (#5199)
description: Schema for report.json, the sanitized evidence artifact. This is the ONLY published view of a run: the run state and cleanup manifest hold disposable passwords, tokens and ExternalIds and are never uploaded. `additionalProperties` is false at the top level and on each case so a future field carrying a credential fails validation instead of shipping silently.

evaluation_id.description: Immutable across attempts. Also the ownership tag value on every resource the run creates, which is what makes cleanup able to delete exactly its own.

attempt_id.description: One per attempt, so a resumed run shows which attempt produced which result.

status.description: The authoritative verdict from cases.accept(). A passing partial suite has full_acceptance=false; incomplete is retained for historical reports.

reasons.description: Empty only when status is passed. Every non-green outcome must say why.

full_acceptance.description: True only for a full-suite run with EVERY case passed and cleanup complete. A partial suite can never set this, however many cases pass, and neither can a run where any case is blocked or not_run — which is what keeps acceptance false while #5413's E16/E17 have no live three-deployment fixture.

partial.description: True unless 'full' was explicitly selected. A union of every named suite is still partial.

owner.description: The story this case proves, e.g. #5185.

summary.description: The expected result, so a reader need not open the code.

status.description: blocked = a required fixture was absent; not_run = never reached. Neither can go green. not_run is the seeded initial state, so a run that dies silently reports honestly instead of showing an empty, reassuring table.

detail.description: Redacted evidence. Token COUNTS are kept as evidence; credential-shaped keys are dropped by report.redact().

cleanup.description: `failed` forces status to failed even when every case passed.

expected_revision.description: The deployed revision the results are bound to. Preflight aborts if the gateway serves anything else.

harness_commit.description: The pinned #5173 harness revision. Not on main, so pinned by immutable SHA rather than tracked from a branch.

environment.description: Account IDs are correlation evidence, not secrets, and are deliberately kept.

tool_versions.description: Pinned provider CLI versions, so a provider release cannot silently change what was exercised.

correlation.description: AWS / ADP / GitHub identifiers tying this run to provider-side records: account IDs, request IDs, role and session names, ADP org/team/user IDs, log group and stream names.

preflight.description: Read-only proof collected before any mutation: the deployed revision actually observed, served CLI hashes, subnet and Cognito findings, and which fixture classes were available.

transcript.description: Sanitized commands: the command path and flag NAMES survive so a reader can reproduce the shape from the runbook; every flag value is replaced.
